subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The government is planning to __abolish __child care leave for female employees.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abolish"** means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. (समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to **abolish** the old tax system.
 
 
 
• **"Establish"** means to set up on a firm or permanent basis, to create or initiate. (स्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company plans to **establish** a new branch in the city.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'abolish'** is **'establish'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eradicate **(उन्मूलन करना): To completely destroy or put an end to something.

 
 
• **Example:** Efforts are being made to** eradicate **poverty in the region.
 
 
 
• **Ensure **(सुनिश्चित करना): To make sure or certain of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The company needs to **ensure** the safety of its workers.
 
 
 
• **Encourage** (प्रोत्साहित करना): To give support, confidence, or hope to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Teachers should** encourage** students to ask questions.
 
 

3e:Tb16,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
